findings.title: check_routes command success is incorrectly treated as zero DRC and zero open nets
findings.evidence: The Tcl records the status return from check_routes and only rejects a false return. The parser requires route_check_return=1 but never parses a violation count. A controlled fixture whose route_check.rpt says TOTAL OPEN NETS = 999 and TOTAL DRC VIOLATIONS = 777 was admitted as PASS_RAW.
findings.minimum_fix: Emit fail-closed machine-readable open-net and DRC counts from a documented ICC2 data source or parse anchored check_routes fields; require both counts to be zero in Tcl and parser, and add positive/negative tests. Do not label command return as DRC closure.

findings.title: SPEF admission accepts the scenario manifest without any actual SPEF
findings.evidence: The parser glob routed*.spef* matches routed.spef_scenario. In a controlled fixture, both actual SPEFs were removed and only routed.spef_scenario remained; parse_pair still returned PASS_RAW.
findings.minimum_fix: Exclude *.spef_scenario and require nonempty SPEF or SPEF.gz payloads for every admitted corner/scenario, with an exact expected inventory and hashes. Add a scenario-manifest-only rejection test.

findings.title: Gate 1 does not prove zero unresolved references or zero mismatch objects
findings.evidence: unresolved_count is hardcoded to 0. get_mismatch_objects -quiet uses the documented default that excludes accepted mismatches. Thus the emitted zero fields can be false while the import gate passes.
findings.minimum_fix: Count get_cells -hierarchical -filter is_unbound==true and is_unmapped as applicable; query every mismatch repair state including accepted explicitly; reject any nonzero value. Record and parse the measured counts.

findings.title: ICC2 and lmutil executable identities are not frozen
findings.evidence: The runner uses fixed paths but neither checks regular/non-symlink/executable type nor pins SHA-256. Current observed hashes are recorded in identity, but absent from the runner.
findings.minimum_fix: Before attempt consumption, require both paths to be regular, non-symlink, executable files and exact-SHA pin ICC2 launcher 825f5d68... and lmutil e7e056cc...; record them in the result receipt.

findings.title: Milkyway physical source is only partially frozen
findings.evidence: The runner pins lib, lib_1, and lib_2 but not the 1044 FRAM masters, two CEL files, or the remaining library metadata. Those are physical inputs consumed by legacy-Milkyway conversion.
findings.minimum_fix: Create and pin a deterministic relative-path, size, SHA-256 inventory for the complete consumed Milkyway reference directory, or at minimum all 94 used FRAM masters plus technology/site CEL data and required indexes.

findings.title: TT, SS, and FF 94-master coverage is not established before NXTGRD
findings.evidence: The 94-master loop calls get_lib_cells */$ref, so one imported logical library can satisfy it. Per-corner TT/SS/FF 94-of-94 coverage is not measured before the Gate-2 token.
findings.minimum_fix: Resolve exact imported TT/SS/FF library identities, require 94/94 mapped masters in each logical view and a physical frame for each, then emit Gate 1.

findings.title: Result parser trusts hardcoded physical-equality facts rather than actual implementation state
findings.evidence: Die/core boxes, pin policy, route layers, CTS/hold policies, and same-route-effort are written as constants. ports_sorted.txt contains names only, not actual layers/locations. The parser asserts same_floorplan_pins_constraints_corners_route_effort=true without deriving it.
findings.minimum_fix: Emit actual queried die/core geometry, complete sorted port name/layer/location inventory, scenario/corner status, route-layer limits, and optimization policy signatures; require exact equality across axes.

findings.title: The pinned physical-audit minimum route calls for post-physical equivalence, but no equivalence gate exists
findings.evidence: The addendum sealed into the runner lists post-physical equivalence as a minimum requirement. The contract, Tcl, parser, and authorization allow no Formality or equivalent post-route check.
findings.minimum_fix: Either add a separately reviewed post-route equivalence step and identity, or narrow the addendum/claim boundary explicitly so this experiment is only an implementation feasibility result that cannot establish functional post-route admission.

findings.title: Generated implementation reports are mostly checked only for non-emptiness
findings.evidence: Clock QoR, timing reports, congestion, wirelength, mismatch, and pre-stage checks are not semantically cross-checked against machine_facts. design_library.rpt, final_design.rpt, and vectorless_power_diagnostic.rpt are generated but not required by the parser.
findings.minimum_fix: Require the full declared report inventory and cross-check key counts/values against independent report text or machine-readable tool attributes.

findings.title: Normalized SDC stripping relies on source hashes rather than explicit removal cardinality
findings.evidence: The normalizer removes any operating-condition line and any wire-load command/continuation but does not assert exactly one operating-condition command and exactly one two-line ZeroWireload command per source.
findings.minimum_fix: Count and require exactly 1 operating-condition line, 1 wire-load header, and 1 continuation line for each pinned SDC before comparing normalized contents and SHA.

positive_observations: The shell is one-shot, consumes an attempt before the license query, has no automatic retry, and quarantines incomplete work.
The release gate binds runner, Tcl, parser, and contract SHA identities through the independent review.
The same-UID collision guard explicitly covers common_shell_exec and common_shell_exe.
The source order correctly places legacy Milkyway creation/link checks before NXTGRD advanced sanity and physical implementation.
Both axes use one common normalized SDC and the same Tcl, floorplan constants, routing layers, CTS/hold whitelist source, and sequential execution.
Negative setup/hold and unmatched-floorplan unit tests pass fail-closed.
verdict: FAIL_NO_AUTHORIZATION. Repair P0 and P1 findings under a new source identity, then perform a fresh independent double-sealed hammer before any lmstat or ICC2 run.
